title: She Vanished Over the Pacific and Was Never Found
description:
In 1937, Amelia Earhart was attempting to fly around the world at the equator when she and navigator Fred Noonan vanished over the Pacific Ocean. The largest search in US history at the time found nothing. Almost ninety years later, no one knows what happened to them.

scenes.text: In 1937, the most famous pilot in the world vanished over the Pacific Ocean, and was never found.
On 02/07/1937, Amelia Earhart and navigator Fred Noonan were flying the final leg of an attempt to circle the globe.
Their target was Howland Island, a strip of land two miles long, lost in the middle of the Pacific Ocean.
Her last radio message said she was running low on fuel and couldn't find the island. Then the radio went silent.
The US Navy launched the largest search in history at the time. It found absolutely nothing.
Nearly ninety years later, there's no wreckage, no bodies, and still no answer for what happened to Amelia Earhart.
